name: Austral-Veil
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in tectonic rift valleys. Travelers navigate by ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Instruments disagree about signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
